nora-finance: Quick question  Invoice from DataForge Pvt Ltd (IN) came in billed to Redwood, Inc (US). Vendor emailed asking Redwood to gross-up so they receive the full invoiced amount after potential US withholding. Can tax advise?

nora-finance: Invoice summary: INV-DF-0626; Vendor GSTIN: 27DFGHI1234L1Z2; Amount: $12,000; No tax shown on invoice. Vendor request: "please pay gross amount or confirm W-8 required".

amit-vendor: Hi I'm Amit from DataForge. We're an Indian company. We do remote model tuning from India. We don't have a US TIN. If Redwood pays from US entity we worry about 30% withholding. We prefer Redwood grosses up so our bank receives $12,000 net.

sarah: Tax: If payment is from the US entity and services are US-source, withholding could apply. Preferred flow: vendor completes W-8BEN-E to certify foreign status and claim treaty benefits (if any), then withholding may be reduced or not required depending on source. We generally do not gross-up for vendors; it's not standard practice.

mike: Sales: The PO references Redwood, Inc (US). @lina-sales can you check whether account team can re-bill to Redwood Services Ltd (UK) or Redwood India to avoid US withholding?

lina-sales: Checking now  account says client asked billing to US for contractual reasons. They can request a change but it may delay acceptance.

sarah: Two points: (1) Source of services: if all work was performed in India, services may be foreign-source and not subject to US withholding. Vendor should provide a short statement confirming location of performance + W-8BEN-E to certify foreign status. (2) If vendor refuses W-8 and we must withhold, we will withhold on reportable US-source payments; we won't gross-up. We can provide a net vs gross payment statement so the vendor understands the math.

amit-vendor: We can provide a signed statement that all work performed in India. We don't know how to fill W-8BEN-E. Any help?

sarah: We can share a W-8 guidance template. Action items: vendor provides signed statement of performance location + attempt to complete W-8BEN-E. Finance will pause payment until docs received. If W-8 completed and indicates foreign status, we'll validate and likely pay full amount without withholding. If not, we'll calculate withholding and remit to IRS. We won't gross-up.

invoicebot: INV-DF-0626 uploaded to NetSuite. Hold reason: TAX_DOC_PENDING.

mike: Amit  I'll DM you the W-8 guidance and loop legal if needed. Can you return the docs by EOD?

amit-vendor: Yes we'll try to return signed statement + W-8 draft today. Thanks for the guidance.

nora-finance: Thanks all  holding payment until docs. Finance: when W-8 + statement arrive, validate and release if foreign status confirmed; otherwise calculate withholding and notify vendor.
